name: Anthropic Skills
tagline: Anthropic's official skill library - ready-made abilities you install in Claude to handle documents, design, testing, and more.
sentence: Installs pre-built abilities into Claude so it can create PowerPoints, audit web apps, design brand guidelines, and handle PDFs - skills it didn't have out of the box.

board.say: Claude is general-purpose but doesn't know your specific workflows out of the box - it can't make a slide deck or audit an app without detailed instructions every time.

watch: **Example skills, not production-guaranteed.** The README says these are 'for demonstration and educational purposes only.'
**Document skills are source-available, not Apache 2.0.** The DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX skills have a different license from the rest.
**431 open issues and 1,100 open pull requests** suggest the repo is very busy but also has a large backlog.
**Skills work differently across platforms.** Test in your environment - Claude Code, claude.ai, and the API each handle skills slightly differently.
